notes.title: LoveKami -Divinity Stage- Update
notes.notes:
Hi all

We have updated LoveKami -Divinity Stage- with the following: 

Simplified Chinese Version
Simplified Chinese has been added to the game setting.


English Version
Animation performance had been adjusted.

notes.title: LoveKami -Divinity Stage- Chinese Version Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

More than a year has passed since our beloved Goddesses descended upon our earth. There have been many things to learn, for them, but they are back again, performing for the Chinese audience! 

LoveKami -Divinity Stage- has just had a DLC for the Chinese version added!
The DLC is free, and is used together with the paid English version.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26940712/ab3b884b9cf18775e54ef989d5d4584b05964a40.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/547340/LoveKami_Divinity_Stage/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/881830/____LoveKami_Divinity_Stage_Simplified_Chinese/

notes.title: Update - Fixed Offline Play
notes.notes:
Hi All

In the recent update where we added wallpapers to celebrate the release of LoveKami -Useless Goddess-, we also fixed the problem with LoveKami -Divinity Stage- running offline. 

You can now play the game offline! 


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26940712/ac6ca8e6a60c498f8ac184cf8b98a8a3b8275c5d.jpg


We hope you keep enjoying the game.

notes.title: LoveKami -Divinity Stage- New Trailer & Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi All

Today we are announcing the release date for LoveKami -Divinity Stage-!
December 16, 2016! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26940712/711bdc1b1fc2052008cf5bffd3bd7fbef0e37716.jpg

Be sure to add LoveKami -Divinity Stage- to your wishlist now to be notified when it is released! 

Also, we have released a new trailer for the game. Here you can see more of the gameplay aspects and meet the characters. 

https://youtu.be/Mrz3zRpPzXI

We hope you are looking forward to it!


Make sure you check out our website:
http://moenovel.com/lovekami


Add LoveKami to your Wishlist now: 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/547340
